[IMMUTABLE_UPDATE_IN_STORE] "store.toasts.0" was replaced with a fresh object whose leaves are mostly the same values (2 of 4 unchanged, 2 changed) — a spread-copy update. The store already tracks leaves; a new container makes every reader of "store.toasts.0" re-run for the few that moved. Instead, assign the leaf on the draft (`store.toasts.0.<key> = …`) so only readers of that key re-run. For data arriving from outside (a fetch result), merge it with reconcile(data, key)(store.toasts.0).
